scope: Classification of the three current AAA-023:A04 failures

findings.cause: The metric script resolves packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/ContextMeter.tsx from git-listed source paths. The path is tracked but deleted in the current worktree; the replacement packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/input/ContextMeter.tsx exists only as an untracked path.
findings.owner: The source-move candidate tree and release qualification integrator
findings.safe_action: Represent the complete source move in one candidate tree before rerunning the path gate. Do not change the metric script to ignore a tracked deletion or stage/commit the user's source move without explicit repository-state authority.

findings.cause: The rescope script reads the same tracked ContextMeter.tsx path and receives ENOENT while the replacement source remains untracked.
findings.owner: The source-move candidate tree and release qualification integrator
findings.safe_action: Resolve the same source move in the same candidate tree as the canonical metrics gate; no independent vendor-postcondition repair is justified.

findings.cause: The current uncommitted Web bundle hardening disables the cordis-host-runner row. The shipped cordis preset still mounts tool-cordis, whose inject list requires cordisInspect; cordis-host-runner owns that service, so the fail-loud Loader reports that tool-cordis is waiting for cordisInspect.
findings.owner: Web bundle host-plane composition and the cordis agent preset
findings.safe_action: Preserve disabled dynamic execution and browser delivery while making the host inspection service available to the cordis preset, for example by enabling cordis-host-runner with explicit deployment: disabled and browserDelivery: disabled. Keep cordis-client-runner, ui-cordis, and plugin-manager controls disabled unless a separate deployment policy opts in. Validate the expected profile test and the dynamic-extension policy gates before any release claim.
evidence: packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml changes cordis-host-runner to disabled: true
AUTH-AAA-023-DECISIONS-A17-001 authorizes explicit dynamic-extension disabled-default controls and compatibility validation

limitations: This classification does not seal an immutable candidate and does not authorize staging, committing, publication, registry writes, push, merge, release, or final verdict.
The recommended Web composition repair needs a successor implementation-ready gate because the existing gate is bound to the completed A03 source-repair scope.
